study_identification_part.si4_title: Heterogeneous brain dynamic functional connectivity patterns in first-episode drug-naive patients with major depressive disorder

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Identify heterogenous subtypes within first-episode drug-naive major depressive disorder (FEDN-MDD) by applying a multivariate unsupervised normative modeling approach to dynamic functional connectivity features, and compare clinical and structural characteristics across subtypes.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Permutation-based pseudo two-sample t-tests (SnPM13; n=5000) comparing intra-IC functional connectivity among Healthy-base controls and subtypes (age, sex, education as covariates); VBM comparisons via permutation tests (n=10000; covariates: age, sex, education, TIV). Clinical comparisons included illness duration differences (p = .03).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Two FEDN-MDD subtypes showed distinct dynamic functional connectivity and gray matter deviation patterns; subtype I exhibited larger extreme deviations and shorter illness duration, whereas subtype II showed weaker deviations with longer illness duration.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Identified 10 informative IC networks (e.g., DMN, frontoparietal, ACC-hub). Subtype I (n=14) had more widespread FC abnormalities and predominantly decreased GM in temporal and ACC regions; subtype II (n=75) showed fewer FC differences vs. controls and both increased and decreased GM widely. Illness duration: subtype I 11.75 ± 12.09 months vs. subtype II 22.12 ± 23.92 months (p = .03).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Combined normative modeling of dynamic FC features with repeated feature selection and clustering (100-run stability); used independent healthy-ICA cohort to guide subject-specific IC derivation.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Cross-sectional single FEDN cohort; generalizability limited by small subtype I (n=14). Choice of k-means and empirical IC number may be suboptimal; treatment effects not assessed (treatment-naive sample). Illness duration range relatively limited.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Acquisition parameters: TR=2000 ms, TE=30 ms, FA=90°, volumes ≥210, eyes open. Healthy-base controls (n=91) matched on sex, age, education via R MatchIt from same-center controls (n=164). Additional healthy-ICA controls (n=125) from two centers used solely to compute group-level ICs. Motion indices: mean FD and max FD summarized in Table 1 (mean ~0.07, max ~0.44 for Healthy-base).
